# Core Set II coverage ledger (generated)

The measured snapshot of the three rosters Core Set II returns to, against the whole live pool. Generated by `npx tsx scripts/core-set-2-ledger.ts`; the per-card rows are in `core-set-2-ledger.json`. What the numbers mean for the set is read in [core-set-2-brief.md](core-set-2-brief.md), section 3.

Rosters: base-set cards by source file (`tk-*.ts`, `greek.ts`, `beastkin.ts`; the base set's generic spells, artifacts and lands are "base generic"); cards from later sets join a roster by subtype (Beastkin, Wei/Shu/Wu/Jin, Olympian). Collectible cards only. Role tags are structural reads of each card's ops, not a power score.
